# Test fixtures

Shared inputs for unit tests and for phases that start before real data exists.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `map-minimal.json` | A 200 m east–west two-way road through a signalled four-way junction at x = 100, inside an R.420 built-up zone. West arm: dashed centre line, a crosswalk with a stop line before it, a P.127 50 km/h zone bound to the eastbound lane `rw-e` only (x 10 to 96.5). North arm: double solid line and a no-left-turn restriction (P.123a). South arm: one-way northbound (I.407a) with a P.102 no-entry line at its mouth. One NPC car (westbound, starts at t = 0) and one pedestrian (starts when the ego reaches x 40 to 60). Two checkpoints and a finish on the eastbound lanes. |
| `frames-straight.json` | 120 frames (2 s) of `car-sedan` at a constant 15 m/s (54 km/h) along `rw-e` from x = 5, generated by the frame builder. The ego enters the 50 km/h zone at tick 20; 4 km/h over is below every speeding band, so the run is clean. |
| `rule-sample.yaml` | The car speeding rule with two tiers (D6.3.a, D6.5.đ) and `paramBasis`. Danger levels and `sustainS` are sample values. |
| `clauses-sample.yaml` | The two clauses it cites, plus D6.2.a with its real ND 238 amendment. Neither speeding clause is amended by ND 238, so the amendment example uses another clause. |
| `rules-bundle.json` | A car-only `RulesBundle`: the sample rule, its clauses, five sources, two TT 38 speed defaults (`verified: false`), two sign meanings (`figureChecked: null`), the scoring table and a `collisionPolicy`. The policy's accident lists are copied from the ND 168 research; the accident and va chạm clause records themselves are not in this fixture. Source `issued` dates not read from the texts are `null`. |
| `maps-index.json`, `credits.json` | Two entries each. `fixture-osm` is a placeholder entry, not a real map. The CC BY entry in `credits.json` (`models/scooter.glb`) is a sample that exercises `creditLine`; that file is not shipped. The shipped credits are `data/credits/credits.json`, which the release gate reads. |
| `hud-states.json` | `ready`, `running`, `withToasts`, `paused` and `finished` HUD states. The toasts cover a verified clause, an unverified one, an inferred one (suy luận), one with design parameters (ngưỡng của trò chơi), one with an amendment, and a score-only breach. The unverified toast uses a copy of D6.3.a with `verified: false` to exercise the badge; the real record is verified. The two speeding toasts are one episode (`speeding-0`, then `escalated`), so the finished report holds it once at its worst tier. `headingRad` is 0, so `nav.bearingRad` reads as relative in previews. `withToasts` has `speedLimitVerified: false`, and the escalated speeding breach (also in the report) has `basisVerified: false`, as when the limit is an unverified TT 38 default; every other state and breach is verified. Each state carries `controls` (throttle, brakes, steering, handbrake): `ready` has the handbrake on, `running` part throttle, `withToasts` the brake with some left steering. |

Regenerate `frames-straight.json` after a deliberate change with
`UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 npx vitest run src/testing`.
